entities.name: Sri Baduga Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Sri Baduga Museum is a state museum located in Bandung, Indonesia. As a state museum, the museum features various items related with the province of West Java, such as Sundanese crafts, furnishings, geologic history, and natural diversity.
